# Machine-actionable contract examples

These files implement the nonproduction example referenced in Section M of `MASTER_HANDOFF.md`.

They are designed to demonstrate:

- article 2.0.0 authoring state;
- source, event, claim, approval, and media-rights 1.1.0;
- create publication intent 1.0.0;
- candidate promotion package 2.1.1;
- preview evidence 1.0.0;
- owner batch approval;
- activation evidence 1.1.0;
- evidence-backed release record 2.1.1;
- completion evidence 1.0.0;
- final promotion and release manifests 2.1.1;
- public release marker 1.1.0.

The image files are deterministic nonproduction test fixtures. They are not AI-generated and must never be published.
